provisions.name: Preamble and Recitals
provisions.text:
THIS AGREEMENT, made this 26 day of Dec., 2007, by and between Southern Refrigerated Transport Arkansas corporation ("Carrier") and EXEL INC., a Massachusetts corporation ("Customer").

WHEREAS, Carrier represents that it is engaged in the business of transporting property by motor vehicle as a contract carrier in domestic (interstate and intrastate) and foreign commerce, it is duly and legally registered and/or licensed, as applicable, as a Carrier at the federal, state, Provincial or Canadian levels, as applicable, which enables it to lawfully engage in its business, and it desires to provide such services to Customer for the transportation of general commodities ("Commodities"); and

WHEREAS, Customer arranges for the transportation of Commodities on behalf of the underlying shipper(s) (Customer's principal(s)) of the Commodities ("Shipper") and desires to use Carrier to provide transportation services designed to meet the specialized transportation requirements and needs of Customer and/or Shipper (the "Services").

NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and conditions hereinafter set forth, Carrier and Customer agree as follows:

provisions.name: 1. TERM, RENEWAL AND TERMINATION
provisions.text:
1. TERM, RENEWAL AND TERMINATION

This Agreement shall be effective upon its execution and shall continue for a period of one year from the date of execution or unless earlier terminated by either party, with or without cause, upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party. After the first year, this Agreement shall be extended on a Year-to-year basis unless terminated by either party upon thirty- (30) day's prior written notice to the other party. If at the time of termination, Carrier is in possession of a shipment, Carrier shall ensure it completes its delivery commitment to Customer and no such termination shall release either party from any obligation accruing before such termination or, except as otherwise provided for in this Agreement, preclude either party from exercising any remedies to enforce such obligations.

provisions.name: 2. AGREEMENT NON-EXCLUSIVE
provisions.text:
2. AGREEMENT NON-EXCLUSIVE

The parties agree that the Services provided under the terms of this Agreement will be on a non-exclusive basis. Customer is free to use the services of any other Carrier or may itself perform the Services. Carrier may perform transportation services to others.

provisions.name: 3. SCOPE OF WORK
provisions.repairs: Rejoined subparagraph a), which the scan split across lines 125 and 127, and removed bullet markers.

provisions.name: 4. RECEIPTS AND BILLS OF LADING
provisions.text:
4. RECEIPTS AND BILLS OF LADING

Customer shall issue and Carrier shall sign freight receipts for each shipment in the form acceptable to Customer and the Shipper. If a bill of lading is used as a freight receipt, any terms, conditions or provisions thereof shall be subject and subordinate to the terms of this Agreement and, in the event of a conflict, this Agreement shall govern. Carrier's or Carrier's agent signature on the receipt or bill of lading shall be prima facie evidence that the Commodities were received in good condition unless otherwise noted on the face of such document. Upon delivery of each shipment, Carrier or Carrier's agent shall obtain a delivery receipt from the consignee(s), in form required by the Shipper, showing the Commodities delivered, their condition at time of delivery and the date and time of delivery.

provisions.name: 5. DELIVERY ARRANGEMENTS; DELAYS; RECONSIGNMENT
provisions.text:
5. DELIVERY ARRANGEMENTS; DELAYS; RECONSIGNMENT

a) Unless otherwise directed by Customer, Carrier shall contact final consignee and all stop-off consignees included in a scheduled shipment to make arrangements, prior to Carrier accepting legal responsibility for the shipment, for appointments necessary to assure the timely delivery and unloading of Commodities. Carrier shall notify Customer of such appointments prior to Carrier moving the trailer from the pickup location.

b) If Carrier encounters pickup or delivery problems that prevent the timely pickup or delivery of all or any part of a shipment, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer by telephone or facsimile for resolution and further instructions.

c) Carrier shall not re-consign any shipment or any scheduled stop off delivery, without prior authorization from Customer, and the procedures of Exhibit A shall control with respect thereto.

d) Refused or undelivered shipments and the Carriers' obligations for the same shall be as set forth in Exhibit A.

provisions.name: 6. COMPENSATION AND BILLING
provisions.text:
6. COMPENSATION AND BILLING

a) Commodities shall be transported in accordance with the rates, charges, and special services listed in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto. Amendments to Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto shall be reduced to writing, signed by both parties and become effective upon the date noted in said Amendment.

b) Carrier acknowledges that the rates, charges and special services in Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto are reasonable for the providing of the Services upon the terms and conditions of this Agreement. Changes to the rates, charges and special services shall be pursuant to amendments to Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto. If Carrier desires to propose a change to the rates, charges and special services, it shall provide Customer at least 60 days prior written notice.

c) Except as otherwise provided herein, the rates, charges and special services set forth in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto (and/or an effective amendment thereto) shall be the sole rates, charges and special services which Customer will pay Carrier. These rates, charges and special services will supersede any other previous rates, charges and special services that may have been in effect between the parties prior to the date hereof. However, the parties intend by this Agreement to ratify, to the fullest extent permitted by law, all acts performed by either of them pursuant to any prior contract between them which purported to be a contract Broker agreement. If Carrier believes that Customer has requested it to perform any services outside the scope of this Agreement or the Exhibits and the Schedules thereto for which Carrier seeks additional compensation or accessorial charges, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer thereof by telephone or facsimile for resolution of such issue and a response as to whether additional compensation or accessorial charges shall be paid or reimbursed, which response shall be confirmed in writing. No additional or accessorial charges shall be assessed or paid without the prior approval of Customer.

d) Carrier shall be paid within thirty (30) days of receipt by Customer, or its designee, of a correct invoice consisting of the original freight bill, in duplicate, or certified original copies and a master bill of lading. Such original freight bill must be presented to Customer within one hundred and eighty (180) days from the date of shipment. Absent an original freight bill within this allotted time all transportation charges due on any such shipment shall be cancelled by Carrier. Carrier shall also submit any documentation and/or supporting material as may be required by Customer. Carrier will submit copies of unloading/lumping receipts, Com-checks/T-checks and the like for driver unloads and bills of lading with original Carrier invoice. Carrier agrees to keep full, complete, and accurate records of Commodities moved and to maintain signed receipts for pick-up and delivery, to be provided to Customer to support Carrier's billing if requested by Customer. Carrier agrees to look exclusively to Customer for payment and expressly waives any claim it may have for unpaid rates or charges against Shipper or consignee. Carrier agrees that no penalties or interest will be assessed to Customer for past due amounts.

e) No changes to this Agreement, Exhibits or Schedules (including by reason of fuel surcharges, interest charges, penalty provisions provided for by statute or regulation, and rate changes resulting from application of general increases to common Carrier tariff rates) shall be applicable or made without the express prior written consent of Customer and Carrier.

f) The provisions of 49 CFR Part 378, as amended, entitled "Procedures Governing the Processing, Investigation and Disposition of Overcharges, Duplicate Payment, or Over collection Claims", shall apply as a process of resolving overcharge or duplicate payment claims thereunder.

provisions.name: 7. LIMITATION ON ACTIONS FOR CHARGES AND FEES
provisions.text:
7. LIMITATION ON ACTIONS FOR CHARGES AND FEES

a) If Carrier seeks to collect additional charges or if Customer seeks to contest charges originally billed or additional charges subsequently billed, Carrier must issue a bill for such additional charges within 180 days of the original bill and Customer must contest the original or additional charges within 180 days of its receipt of the bill for the same. If either party, after compliance with the first sentence hereof, desires to bring an action at law against the other party to recover undercharges or overcharges, the action shall be commenced not more than 18 months from delivery or tender of delivery by Carrier. Failure to commence an action within this period shall constitute full and final acknowledgement and acceptance of payment of all charges.

b) In the event an action is initiated, the prevailing party's reasonable attorney's fees, costs and expenses shall be paid by the non-prevailing party.

provisions.name: 8. INDEMNIFICATION
provisions.text:
8. INDEMNIFICATION

Carrier and Carrier's agents shall indemnify, defend and hold Customer harmless from all losses, damages, expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees), actions and claims for injury or death to persons and damage to property (including the property of Customer or its employees but excluding the Commodities) asserted against Customer by any person (including, without limitation, Carrier's and Carrier's agents and Customer's employees) arising out of or resulting from the performance of the Services by Carrier or its agents and underlying carriers, or employees except to the extent (but only to the extent) caused by the negligence of Customer, its agents or employees.

provisions.name: 9. LIABILITIES AND CLAIMS FOR COMMODITIES
provisions.text:
9. LIABILITIES AND CLAIMS FOR COMMODITIES

a) Carrier shall be liable to Customer for loss, damage or injury to the Commodities tendered to Carrier for transportation hereunder while the Commodities are in its, its agent or underlying carrier's custody, possession or control except to the extent (and only to the extent) such loss, damage or injury results from (i) acts of God, the public enemy or public authority, (ii) inherent vice or nature of the Commodities, or (iii) the negligent acts of Customer or Shipper.

b) The measurement of the loss, damage or injury to Commodities shall be the Shipper's replacement value applicable to the kind and quantity of Commodities so lost, damaged or destroyed. Customer shall deduct from the invoice price the reasonable salvage value of any damaged or injured Commodities not released to Carrier. Carrier acknowledges that some of the Commodities may be disposed of in a manner that will prevent the damaged goods from being sold on the open market.

c) Carrier's liability on any claim for alleged loss, damage or delay (a "Claim"), and the procedures involved in processing any such Claim, shall be governed by 49 C.F.R. Part 370. Carrier acknowledges that it assumes liability to Customer and shall indemnify and hold Customer harmless from any liability Customer may incur because of delays in delivering the Commodities.

d) If any Commodities are lost, damaged or injured, Customer and/or Shipper or consignee must submit a detailed Claim in writing within nine (9) months of date of delivery; and Carrier shall settle or disallow such Claim within sixty (60) days of date of receipt of a Claim.

e) The time limit for instituting suit against the Carrier shall be two (2) years and a day from the date on which the person filing a Claim (whether Customer or Shipper or consignee) receives a valid written disallowance from Carrier.

f) A letter of disallowance from Carrier must state a lawful reason for declining to accept liability on the Claim.
provisions.repairs: Removed list bullet markers; the second sentence of subparagraph c) appears struck through by hand in the original and is reproduced here as plain text.

provisions.name: 11. SAFETY RATING
provisions.text:
11. SAFETY RATING

Carrier warrants that it and all underlying carrier's Carrier utilizes has received a "Satisfactory" safety rating as issued by the federal Department of Transportation. Carrier will not tender any Customer freight to any carrier that has a "Conditional" or "Unsatisfactory" safety rating.

provisions.name: 12. COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS
provisions.text:
12. COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS

a) Carrier and all underlying carriers will ensure they comply with all current or future applicable, federal, state and local laws, rules or regulations, including but not limited to; (i) commingling of Commodities with any hazardous substances or poisons as defined by the D.O.T., E.P.A., F.D.A. and all other applicable federal, state and local laws, rules or regulations relating thereto; and (ii) the requirements of the Sanitary Food Transportation Act of 1990 and any regulations derived therefrom, including shipping Commodities only with food and acceptable non-food products as defined in Sanitary Food Transportation Act of 1990.

b) Carrier agrees it will promptly notify Customer of any of the following which is connected with the Services provided under this Agreement: (i) any indictment, lawsuit or administrative or other proceeding issued or instituted by any federal, state or Canadian, Provincial or local governmental entity or agency against Carrier; or (ii) the revocation of any license, permit or other document issued to Carrier by any such entity or agency.

provisions.name: 13. NOTICES
provisions.text:
13. NOTICES

All notices and amendments shall be in writing and shall be properly given and delivered in person or sent prepaid by a reputable overnight delivery service such as DHL or Federal Express or by registered or certified mail (Return Receipt Requested) or by Facsimile (provided a hard copy is promptly sent by one of the other means set forth herein) to the following addresses:

provisions.name: 14. SURVIVABILITY
provisions.text:
14. SURVIVABILITY

All indemnities, warranties, guarantees and obligations contained and given by Carrier herein shall continue in full force and effect during the term hereof and shall survive and continue after expiration, termination or cancellation of this Agreement and shall be binding upon the Carrier and its successors and assigns.

provisions.name: 15. ASSIGNMENT OF AGREEMENT; SUBSIDIARIES AND DIVISIONS
provisions.text:
15. ASSIGNMENT OF AGREEMENT; SUBSIDIARIES AND DIVISIONS

Neither Customer or Carrier shall assign or transfer this Agreement in whole or in part or without the prior written consent of the other party; provided, however, that Customer, for the purposes of this Agreement, shall mean Exel Inc. and its subsidiaries and divisions and Carrier agrees to provide to any subsidiary or divisions of Exel Inc. motor Carrier services upon the terms and conditions and rates set forth in this Agreement and the Exhibits and Schedules thereto, as the same may be amended from time to time.

provisions.name: 16. DEFAULT
provisions.text:
16. DEFAULT

If either party to this Agreement fails to correct any default thereunder within thirty (30) days after receipt from other party of a written request to do so, the party requesting such correction may, at the expiration of such thirty (30) day period, terminate this Agreement forthwith.

provisions.name: 17. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR
provisions.text:
17. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR

Carrier is an independent contractor and shall have exclusive control and direction of the persons providing the Services on its behalf. Carrier assumes full responsibility for (and shall defend and indemnify Customer against) the payment of local, state and federal or Canadian, Provincial or local, as applicable, payroll taxes or contributions or taxes for unemployment insurance, pensions, worker's compensation, or other social security and related protection with respect to the persons engaged by it in the performance of the Services.

provisions.name: 18. INVALIDITY OF PROVISIONS
provisions.text:
18. INVALIDITY OF PROVISIONS

Should any part of this Agreement for any reason be invalid or unenforceable, such invalidity or unenforceability shall not effect the validity or enforceability of any remaining portion, which remaining portion, to the fullest extent permitted by law, shall continue in full force and effect as if this Agreement had been executed with the invalid or unenforceable portion hereof eliminated, it being the intention of the parties that they would have executed the remaining portion of this Agreement without including any such part, parts or portions which may for any reason be hereafter declared invalid or unenforceable.

provisions.name: 19. CONFIDENTIALITY OF INFORMATION
provisions.text:
19. CONFIDENTIALITY OF INFORMATION

All information with respect to Customer's costs, pricing information, procedures, computer software systems, and other details of Customer's business obtained by Carrier in connection with the performance of the Services is confidential and shall not, without Customer's prior written consent, be disclosed by Carrier, its employees or agents to any third person.

provisions.name: 20. APPLICABLE LAW
provisions.text:
20. APPLICABLE LAW

THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE GOVERNED BY AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE APPLICABLE LAWS OF THE UNITED STATES OR THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF OHIO AND THE PARTIES HEREBY SUBMIT, AS APPLICABLE, TO JURISDICTION AND VENUE IN THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL DISTRICT COURTS LOCATED IN THE SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF OHIO AND THE STATE COURTS LOCATED IN OHIO.

provisions.name: 21. FORCE MAJEURE
provisions.text:
21. FORCE MAJEURE

Neither Customer nor Carrier shall be held liable for failure to perform any of the terms and conditions of this Agreement (not including the payment of any monies) when such failure to perform is occasioned by Acts of God or circumstances and/or conditions occurring without human intervention and which no amount of foresight, precaution, or care reasonably exercised could have prevented.

provisions.name: 22. OTHER DOCUMENTS; AUDIT
provisions.text:
22. OTHER DOCUMENTS; AUDIT

The terms, conditions and provisions of any invoice, billing statement, confirmation, receipt, bill of lading or other similar document relating to the Services rendered in connection with this Agreement shall be subject and subordinate to the terms, provisions and conditions of this Agreement and, in the event of a conflict between the terms, conditions and provisions of any such document and of this Agreement, the terms, conditions and provisions of this Agreement shall govern.

The rates, rules and regulations contained in this Agreement, and the Exhibits and Schedules thereto, will be the sole provisions governing the Services and will override any previous contract or tariff rates between the parties that may be on file. Any conflict between the provision set forth in this Agreement and the terms of any tariff it references shall be resolved in favor of the provisions set forth herein.

Customer and its duly authorized representatives shall have access to the accounting records and other documents maintained by Carrier which relate to the Services set forth in this Agreement, and shall have the right to review and copy such records at any reasonable time or times during the term of this Agreement and for a period of two years after such termination.

provisions.name: 23. ASSIGNABILITY OF CONTRACT
provisions.text:
23. ASSIGNABILITY OF CONTRACT

The provisions of this Agreement shall be binding upon the parties hereto and upon their successors and assigns for the full term of this Agreement. The parties agree that the terms and obligations herein contained shall not be affected, modified, altered, or changed in any respect by the transfer or assignment from Customer to their underlying Shipper.

provisions.name: 24. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
provisions.text:
24. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement together with the attached Appendix, Exhibits and Schedules thereto and revisions and amendments thereof, contain the complete and exclusive agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter of this Agreement and supersedes all prior (whether oral or in writing) contracts, correspondence, negotiations or understandings. This Agreement supersedes and cancels all other previous agreements, rates and charges between the parties. If any provisions of the Exhibits and Schedules thereto are in conflict with the Agreement, the provisions of the Exhibits and Schedules shall control.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 100 — Appointment Notification
provisions.text:
ITEM 100

APPOINTMENT NOTIFICATION

1. There shall be no charge assessed by Carrier for any costs or expenses involved in arranging or fulfilling an appointment with respect to pick up and delivery services to consignee or consignor.
2. Request for prearranged scheduling may be via phone or fax.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 120 — Detention With Power
provisions.text:
ITEM 120

DETENTION WITH POWER

1. Rate $65.00 per hour or fraction thereof in excess of the two hours for situations when the Carrier offers a vehicle with a power unit for unloading at an agreed upon time and is unable to accomplish same within two hours. If a Carrier is early or late for an appointment to load or unload the vehicle, the difference between the appointment time and the arrival time shall not be included in the computation of time for the purposes of this item. Carrier shall indicate on freight bill whether detention occurred at origin or destination. The maximum charge is $390.

2. $/hour paid in 15 minute increments.
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslashes before dollar signs.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 130 — Storage, OTR Shipments
provisions.text:
ITEM 130

STORAGE - OTR Shipments

1. Storage in-transit charge (OTR shipments) per day for situations where the Carrier is required by the Shipper to sign for and pick-up a trailer transferring dry freight from Shipper's facilities and hold for a period of time. After the expiration of two (2) business days free time (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, & Friday) charges may be assessed at $40.00 per day. No storage charge will be incurred for the first Saturday and Sunday while in carrier's possession.
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslash before dollar sign.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 140 — Exclusive Use of Vehicle
provisions.text:
ITEM 140 EXCLUSIVE USE OF VEHICLE

1. Each load tendered to Carrier is entitled to exclusive use of the trailer in which it is to be transported, except when a written request for non-exclusive use is provided to Carrier by Shipper.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 170 — Labor, Driver Loading or Unloading
provisions.text:
ITEM 170 LABOR - DRIVER LOADING OR UNLOADING

1. Where consignee requires carrier personnel to sort and segregate freight for delivery, a driver unload charge may be assessed. $0.30 per hundred pounds; subject to a minimum charge of $50.00 per stop, and a maximum of $125 per shipment.
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslashes before dollar signs.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 180 — Layover
provisions.text:
ITEM 180 LAYOVER

1. When, due to conditions beyond the carrier's control, the shipper or the consignee or the consignor cannot accept delivery or cannot complete loading or unloading, causing the carrier's truck and driver to be detained overnight, a layover charge will apply.
2. Rate per day for detention in excess of six hours.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 190 — Pick Up or Delivery
provisions.text:
ITEM 190 PICK UP OR DELIVERY

1. Rates include one pick up and one delivery or one tender for delivery of a shipment, during business hours at one site, subject to the following provisions

Placement of vehicle for loading: At the request of the Shipper, Carrier will furnish and place a vehicle at the loading site designated.

Placement of vehicle for unloading: The delivery of a shipment will include the placing of vehicle at the site designated by the consignee.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 200 — Provisions Included in Base Rates
provisions.text:
ITEM 200 PROVISIONS INCLUDED IN BASE RATES

1. Rates for the Services include one pick up and one delivery service for each shipment hereunder at all points within the commercial zone of the cities, towns, villages and other points from and to which the rates apply, except as otherwise specifically provided herein. The term "delivery" as used herein means the service performed by Carrier or its agent in transporting freight to consignee's receiving location from the Shipper's facilities.
2. Trailers tendered for shipping must be clean, free of odor, and free of insects. It will be the Shipper's sole judgement with the respect to cleanliness and sanitation if the unit is suitable for the transporting of said property.
3. By signing of this Agreement, Carrier certifies that no trailer is used for the transportation of Shipper's product, or for the transportation of items to Shipper, has ever been used for without sufficient cleaning and/or disinfecting or is being used for the hauling (or back hauling) of garbage, trash, hazardous waste, dried animal feed, toxic compound, broken glass, pesticides, fertilizers, petroleum products, solvents, strong aromatic compounds, or metal shavings/fragments, or other similar items.
4. Carrier agrees to take reasonable measures to maintain seal integrity and document and promptly notify Shipper of any seal removal prior to delivery.
5. Carrier shall only be allowed to stage a loaded trailer containing Shipper's products (if not at Shipper's facilities) only at a secure lot. Secure lot meaning: an area which is fenced with a locking gate or an area monitored /patrolled continuously by security.
6. Carrier shall notify shipper immediately of the discovery of any occurrence that results in spoiled, damaged, contaminated or lost freight, regardless of whether or not the product is known to be hazardous, and will await instructions or advice from Shipper before further loading, transporting or delivering any goods potentially affected.
7. Carrier shall provide Customer with shipment information by electronic means within a schedule agreed on by Customer and Carrier.
8. Upon request by Customer, Carrier shall provide written proof of delivery within one (1) working day of the request.
9. Carrier shall contact Customer by telephone or facsimile with notification of all delivery discrepancies (Overages, Shortages, Damages and Refusals) within 24 hours of delivery to receive instructions.
10. 2 hours free time for unloading with power.
11. Single shipment charge.
12. Inspection charge.
provisions.repairs: Joined the item across the page break at lines 388-391.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 210 — Rate Base for Mileage Calculation Applications
provisions.text:
ITEM 210

RATE BASE FOR MILEAGE CALCULATION APPLICATIONS

1. Mileage, if used for rating purposes, will be determined through use of PC Miler 2000, the version of which is in effect for Exel at time of tendering.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 220 — Re-consignments and/or Diversion
provisions.text:
ITEM 220

RE-CONSIGNMENTS AND/OR DIVERSION

1. $150 plus applicable linehaul charge to point of reconsignment. Shipment shall be considered reconsigned if a new destination is identified prior to or after attempted delivery to the original destination on the bill of lading. Mileage to be calculated using PC Miler 2000, the version of which is in effect for Exel at time of tendering.
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslash before dollar sign.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 230 — Return of Shipments
provisions.text:
ITEM 230

RETURN OF SHIPMENTS

1. Shipments, which cannot be delivered for reasons beyond control of the carrier, will be returned to the shipper. The rate applicable for the return of such shipments will be as published in Schedule B herein, which is in effect on the date the shipment is returned.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 240 — Stops in Transit
provisions.text:
ITEM 240

STOPS IN TRANSIT

1. When the carrier is requested to stop at any point(s) other than the initial shipment origin and the final shipment destination, the line haul price will be increased to account for all additional miles. $75.00 for the first additional stop, $125.00 for each stop thereafter with a maximum of 5 stops.
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslashes before dollar signs.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 250 — Expedited Team Service
provisions.text:
ITEM 250 EXPEDITED TEAM SERVICE

1. $0.10 additional per mile surcharge to cover a second driver if expedited service is required to meet Shipper's delivery schedule.
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslash before dollar sign.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 260 — Trailer Placement for Loading
provisions.text:
ITEM 260 TRAILER PLACEMENT FOR LOADING

1. Carrier shall have the right to deliver or drop-at consignor's facilities, with consignor's consent, empty trailers to be loaded by consignor with one or more shipments for transportation by Carrier hereunder. Notwithstanding consignor's consent, each such delivery or drop-off shall be deemed to be for the sole convenience of Carrier and shall not be subject to the payment or collection of any charges for detention or demurrage therefore.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 270 — Truck Ordered Not Used
provisions.text:
ITEM 270 TRUCK ORDERED NOT USED

1. Charge for situations when a driver with power unit is ordered into a facility to pick-up, but is not used. The fee shall not apply if order is cancelled eight or more hours prior to pick-up or if another load is provided. $250.00 minimum charge.
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslash before dollar sign.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 280 — Out of Route Miles
provisions.text:
ITEM 280 OUT OF ROUTE MILES

1. Charge per mile for any out-of-route miles for shipments. Out-of-route miles are defined as any additional miles driven beyond the standard route mileage as calculated using PC Miler 2000, V16 (Practical Miles).

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 290 — Lumper Charges
provisions.text:
ITEM 290 LUMPER CHARGES

1. Whenever the carrier is required to hire a laborer ("lumper") to perform services on behalf of the shipper, consignor or consignee, the carrier will be entitled to reimbursement of actual lumper costs per event. Lumper charges will be passed through on a direct cost basis.
2. The price per shipment should default to the actual cost, and a copy of receipt should accompany carrier freight invoice. Lumper receipts are available upon request.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 300 — Redelivery
provisions.text:
ITEM 300 REDELIVERY

1. If Carrier arrives late for an appointment, and is deemed as the cause for the consignee inability to unload, there will be no redelivery charges applicable.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 310 — Per Diem, Intermodal Only
provisions.text:
ITEM 310 PER DIEM - INTERMODAL ONLY

1. Charge for equipment utilization beyond free time when equipment is out of possession of railroad will be $25 per day after the expiration of free time. Free time for Per Diem is fixed at both Origin and Destination.
2. At the Origin, free time is defined as the day the equipment is picked up from the rail plus two free days. The first weekend is free provided it falls within the free time. If the equipment is picked up on Thursday or Friday, the weekend is free. If it is picked up on Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday, the weekend is not free.
3. At the Destination, free time defined as the notify day plus two free days. The first weekend is free provided it falls within the free time. If the equipment notifies on Thursday or Friday, the weekend is free. If the equipment notifies on Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday, the weekend is not free.
provisions.repairs: Rejoined paragraph 2 across the page break at lines 459-465 and removed the escape backslash before the dollar sign.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 320 — Intermodal Storage
provisions.text:
ITEM 320

INTERMODAL STORAGE

1. Intermodal Storage - After the expiration of two (2) days free time, storage will be assessed at $100.00 per day. Free time will follow the same schedule as Per Diem - Intermodal (Item 310)
provisions.repairs: Removed escape backslash before dollar sign.

44 F.Supp.3d 736_31/Affidavit of Hecker.instrument_name: Master Transportation Services Agreement between Southern Refrigerated Transport and Exel Inc. (Exhibit "A")

provisions.name: Preamble and Recitals
provisions.text:
## MASTER TRANSPORTATION SERVICES AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT, made this 26 day of Dec., 2007, by and between Southern Refrigerated Transport Arkansas corporation ("Carrier") and EXEL INC., a Massachusetts corporation ("Customer").

WHEREAS, Carrier represents that it is engaged in the business of transporting property by motor vehicle as a contract carrier in domestic (interstate and intrastate) and foreign commerce, it is duly and legally registered and/or licensed, as applicable, as a Carrier at the federal, state, Provincial or Canadian levels, as applicable, which enables it to lawfully engage in its business, and it desires to provide such services to Customer for the transportation of general commodities ("Commodities"); and

WHEREAS, Customer arranges for the transportation of Commodities on behalf of the underlying shipper(s) (Customer's principal(s)) of the Commodities ("Shipper") and desires to use Carrier to provide transportation services designed to meet the specialized transportation requirements and needs of Customer and/or Shipper (the "Services").

NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and conditions hereinafter set forth, Carrier and Customer agree as follows:

provisions.name: 1. Term, Renewal and Termination
provisions.text:
## 1. TERM, RENEWAL AND TERMINATION

This Agreement shall be effective upon its execution and shall continue for a period of one year from the date of execution or unless earlier terminated by either party, with or without cause, upon thirty (30) days prior written notice to the other party. After the first year, this Agreement shall be extended on a Year-to-year basis unless terminated by either party upon thirty- (30) day's prior written notice to the other party. If at the time of termination, Carrier is in possession of a shipment, Carrier shall ensure it completes its delivery commitment to Customer and no such termination shall release either party from any obligation accruing before such termination or, except as otherwise provided for in this Agreement, preclude either party from exercising any remedies to enforce such obligations.

provisions.name: 2. Agreement Non-Exclusive
provisions.text:
## 2. AGREEMENT NON-EXCLUSIVE

The parties agree that the Services provided under the terms of this Agreement will be on a non-exclusive basis. Customer is free to use the services of any other Carrier or may itself perform the Services. Carrier may perform transportation services to others.

provisions.name: 3. Scope of Work
provisions.repairs: Rejoined subparagraph a) split across a page break and removed list-bullet debris.

provisions.name: 4. Receipts and Bills of Lading
provisions.text:
## 4. RECEIPTS AND BILLS OF LADING

Customer shall issue and Carrier shall sign freight receipts for each shipment in the form acceptable to Customer and the Shipper. If a bill of lading is used as a freight receipt, any terms, conditions or provisions thereof shall be subject and subordinate to the terms of this Agreement and, in the event of a conflict, this Agreement shall govern. Carrier's or Carrier's agent signature on the receipt or bill of lading shall be prima facie evidence that the Commodities were received in good condition unless otherwise noted on the face of such document. Upon delivery of each shipment, Carrier or Carrier's agent shall obtain a delivery receipt from the consignee(s), in form required by the Shipper, showing the Commodities delivered, their condition at time of delivery and the date and time of delivery.

provisions.name: 5. Delivery Arrangements; Delays; Reconsignment
provisions.text:
## 5. DELIVERY ARRANGEMENTS; DELAYS; RECONSIGNMENT

a) Unless otherwise directed by Customer, Carrier shall contact final consignee and all stop-off consignees included in a scheduled shipment to make arrangements, prior to Carrier accepting legal responsibility for the shipment, for appointments necessary to assure the timely delivery and unloading of Commodities. Carrier shall notify Customer of such appointments prior to Carrier moving the trailer from the pickup location.

b) If Carrier encounters pickup or delivery problems that prevent the timely pickup or delivery of all or any part of a shipment, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer by telephone or facsimile for resolution and further instructions.

c) Carrier shall not re-consign any shipment or any scheduled stop off delivery, without prior authorization from Customer, and the procedures of Exhibit A shall control with respect thereto.

d) Refused or undelivered shipments and the Carriers' obligations for the same shall be as set forth in Exhibit A.

provisions.name: 6. Compensation and Billing
provisions.text:
## 6. COMPENSATION AND BILLING

a) Commodities shall be transported in accordance with the rates, charges, and special services listed in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto. Amendments to Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto shall be reduced to writing, signed by both parties and become effective upon the date noted in said Amendment.

b) Carrier acknowledges that the rates, charges and special services in Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto are reasonable for the providing of the Services upon the terms and conditions of this Agreement. Changes to the rates, charges and special services shall be pursuant to amendments to Exhibit A and the Schedules thereto. If Carrier desires to propose a change to the rates, charges and special services, it shall provide Customer at least 60 days prior written notice.

c) Except as otherwise provided herein, the rates, charges and special services set forth in Exhibit "A" and the Schedules thereto (and/or an effective amendment thereto) shall be the sole rates, charges and special services which Customer will pay Carrier. These rates, charges and special services will supersede any other previous rates, charges and special services that may have been in effect between the parties prior to the date hereof. However, the parties intend by this Agreement to ratify, to the fullest extent permitted by law, all acts performed by either of them pursuant to any prior contract between them which purported to be a contract Broker agreement. If Carrier believes that Customer has requested it to perform any services outside the scope of this Agreement or the Exhibits and the Schedules thereto for which Carrier seeks additional compensation or accessorial charges, Carrier shall immediately notify Customer thereof by telephone or facsimile for resolution of such issue and a response as to whether additional compensation or accessorial charges shall be paid or reimbursed, which response shall be confirmed in writing. No additional or accessorial charges shall be assessed or paid without the prior approval of Customer.

d) Carrier shall be paid within thirty (30) days of receipt by Customer, or its designee, of a correct invoice consisting of the original freight bill, in duplicate, or certified original copies and a master bill of lading. Such original freight bill must be presented to Customer within one hundred and eighty (180) days from the date of shipment. Absent an original freight bill within this allotted time all transportation charges due on any such shipment shall be cancelled by Carrier. Carrier shall also submit any documentation and/or supporting material as may be required by Customer. Carrier will submit copies of unloading/lumping receipts, Com-checks/T-checks and the like for driver unloads and bills of lading with original Carrier invoice. Carrier agrees to keep full, complete, and accurate records of Commodities moved and to maintain signed receipts for pick-up and delivery, to be provided to Customer to support Carrier's billing if requested by Customer. Carrier agrees to look exclusively to Customer for payment and expressly waives any claim it may have for unpaid rates or charges against Shipper or consignee. Carrier agrees that no penalties or interest will be assessed to Customer for past due amounts.

e) No changes to this Agreement, Exhibits or Schedules (including by reason of fuel surcharges, interest charges, penalty provisions provided for by statute or regulation, and rate changes resulting from application of general increases to common Carrier tariff rates) shall be applicable or made without the express prior written consent of Customer and Carrier.

f) The provisions of 49 CFR Part 378, as amended, entitled "Procedures Governing the Processing, Investigation and Disposition of Overcharges, Duplicate Payment, or Over collection Claims", shall apply as a process of resolving overcharge or duplicate payment claims thereunder.

provisions.name: 7. Limitation on Actions for Charges and Fees
provisions.text:
## 7. LIMITATION ON ACTIONS FOR CHARGES AND FEES

a) If Carrier seeks to collect additional charges or if Customer seeks to contest charges originally billed or additional charges subsequently billed, Carrier must issue a bill for such additional charges within 180 days of the original bill and Customer must contest the original or additional charges within 180 days of its receipt of the bill for the same. If either party, after compliance with the first sentence hereof, desires to bring an action at law against the other party to recover undercharges or overcharges, the action shall be commenced not more than 18 months from delivery or tender of delivery by Carrier. Failure to commence an action within this period shall constitute full and final acknowledgement and acceptance of payment of all charges.

b) In the event an action is initiated, the prevailing party's reasonable attorney's fees, costs and expenses shall be paid by the non-prevailing party.
provisions.repairs: Removed list-bullet debris and heading emphasis markers.

provisions.name: 8. Indemnification
provisions.text:
## 8. INDEMNIFICATION

Carrier and Carrier's agents shall indemnify, defend and hold Customer harmless from all losses, damages, expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees), actions and claims for injury or death to persons and damage to property (including the property of Customer or its employees but excluding the Commodities) asserted against Customer by any person (including, without limitation, Carrier's and Carrier's agents and Customer's employees) arising out of or resulting from the performance of the Services by Carrier or its agents and underlying carriers, or employees except to the extent (but only to the extent) caused by the negligence of Customer, its agents or employees.

provisions.name: 9. Liabilities and Claims for Commodities
provisions.text:
## 9. LIABILITIES AND CLAIMS FOR COMMODITIES

a) Carrier shall be liable to Customer for loss, damage or injury to the Commodities tendered to Carrier for transportation hereunder while the Commodities are in its, its agent or underlying carrier's custody, possession or control except to the extent (and only to the extent) such loss, damage or injury results from (i) acts of God, the public enemy or public authority, (ii) inherent vice or nature of the Commodities, or (iii) the negligent acts of Customer or Shipper.

b) The measurement of the loss, damage or injury to Commodities shall be the Shipper's replacement value applicable to the kind and quantity of Commodities so lost, damaged or destroyed. Customer shall deduct from the invoice price the reasonable salvage value of any damaged or injured Commodities not released to Carrier. Carrier acknowledges that some of the Commodities may be disposed of in a manner that will prevent the damaged goods from being sold on the open market.

c) Carrier's liability on any claim for alleged loss, damage or delay (a "Claim"), and the procedures involved in processing any such Claim, shall be governed by 49 C.F.R. Part 370. Carrier acknowledges that it assumes liability to Customer and shall indemnify and hold Customer harmless from any liability Customer may incur because of delays in delivering the Commodities.

d) If any Commodities are lost, damaged or injured, Customer and/or Shipper or consignee must submit a detailed Claim in writing within nine (9) months of date of delivery; and Carrier shall settle or disallow such Claim within sixty (60) days of date of receipt of a Claim.

e) The time limit for instituting suit against the Carrier shall be two (2) years and a day from the date on which the person filing a Claim (whether Customer or Shipper or consignee) receives a valid written disallowance from Carrier.

f) A letter of disallowance from Carrier must state a lawful reason for declining to accept liability on the Claim.
provisions.repairs: Removed list-bullet debris; the second sentence of c) and the opening words of d) appear struck through by hand in the original and are reproduced here as plain text.

provisions.name: 11. Safety Rating
provisions.text:
## 11. SAFETY RATING

Carrier warrants that it and all underlying carrier's Carrier utilizes has received a "Satisfactory" safety rating as issued by the federal Department of Transportation. Carrier will not tender any Customer freight to any carrier that has a "Conditional" or "Unsatisfactory" safety rating.

provisions.name: 12. Compliance with Laws
provisions.text:
## 12. COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS

a) Carrier and all underlying carriers will ensure they comply with all current or future applicable, federal, state and local laws, rules or regulations, including but not limited to; (i) commingling of Commodities with any hazardous substances or poisons as defined by the D.O.T., E.P.A., F.D.A. and all other applicable federal, state and local laws, rules or regulations relating thereto; and (ii) the requirements of the Sanitary Food Transportation Act of 1990 and any regulations derived therefrom, including shipping Commodities only with food and acceptable non-food products as defined in Sanitary Food Transportation Act of 1990.

b) Carrier agrees it will promptly notify Customer of any of the following which is connected with the Services provided under this Agreement: (i) any indictment, lawsuit or administrative or other proceeding issued or instituted by any federal, state or Canadian, Provincial or local governmental entity or agency against Carrier; or (ii) the revocation of any license, permit or other document issued to Carrier by any such entity or agency.

provisions.name: 13. Notices
provisions.text:
## 13. NOTICES

All notices and amendments shall be in writing and shall be properly given and delivered in person or sent prepaid by a reputable overnight delivery service such as DHL or Federal Express or by registered or certified mail (Return Receipt Requested) or by Facsimile (provided a hard copy is promptly sent by one of the other means set forth herein) to the following addresses:

provisions.name: 14. Survivability
provisions.text:
## 14. SURVIVABILITY

All indemnities, warranties, guarantees and obligations contained and given by Carrier herein shall continue in full force and effect during the term hereof and shall survive and continue after expiration, termination or cancellation of this Agreement and shall be binding upon the Carrier and its successors and assigns.

provisions.name: 15. Assignment of Agreement; Subsidiaries and Divisions
provisions.text:
## 15. ASSIGNMENT OF AGREEMENT; SUBSIDIARIES AND DIVISIONS

Neither Customer or Carrier shall assign or transfer this Agreement in whole or in part or without the prior written consent of the other party; provided, however, that Customer, for the purposes of this Agreement, shall mean Exel Inc. and its subsidiaries and divisions and Carrier agrees to provide to any subsidiary or divisions of Exel Inc. motor Carrier services upon the terms and conditions and rates set forth in this Agreement and the Exhibits and Schedules thereto, as the same may be amended from time to time.

provisions.name: 16. Default
provisions.text:
## 16. DEFAULT

If either party to this Agreement fails to correct any default thereunder within thirty (30) days after receipt from other party of a written request to do so, the party requesting such correction may, at the expiration of such thirty (30) day period, terminate this Agreement forthwith.

provisions.name: 17. Independent Contractor
provisions.text:
## 17. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR

Carrier is an independent contractor and shall have exclusive control and direction of the persons providing the Services on its behalf. Carrier assumes full responsibility for (and shall defend and Indemnify Customer against) the payment of local, state and federal or Canadian, Provincial or local, as applicable, payroll taxes or contributions or taxes for unemployment insurance, pensions, worker's compensation, or other social security and related protection with respect to the persons engaged by it in the performance of the Services.

provisions.name: 18. Invalidity of Provisions
provisions.text:
## 18. INVALIDITY OF PROVISIONS

Should any part of this Agreement for any reason be invalid or unenforceable, such invalidity or unenforceability shall not effect the validity or enforceability of any remaining portion, which remaining portion, to the fullest extent permitted by law, shall continue in full force and effect as if this Agreement had been executed with the invalid or unenforceable portion hereof eliminated, it being the intention of the parties that they would have executed the remaining portion of this Agreement without including any such part, parts or portions which may for any reason be hereafter declared invalid or unenforceable.

provisions.name: 19. Confidentiality of Information
provisions.text:
## 19. CONFIDENTIALITY OF INFORMATION

All information with respect to Customer's costs, pricing information, procedures, computer software systems, and other details of Customer's business obtained by Carrier in connection with the performance of the Services is confidential and shall not, without Customer's prior written consent, be disclosed by Carrier, its employees or agents to any third person.

provisions.name: 20. Applicable Law
provisions.text:
## 20. APPLICABLE LAW

THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE GOVERNED BY AND CONSTRUED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE APPLICABLE LAWS OF THE UNITED STATES OR THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF OHIO AND THE PARTIES HEREBY SUBMIT, AS APPLICABLE, TO JURISDICTION AND VENUE IN THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL DISTRICT COURTS LOCATED IN THE SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF OHIO AND THE STATE COURTS LOCATED IN OHIO.

provisions.name: 21. Force Majeure
provisions.text:
## 21. FORCE MAJEURE

Neither Customer nor Carrier shall be held liable for failure to perform any of the terms and conditions of this Agreement (not including the payment of any monies) when such failure to perform is occasioned by Acts of God or circumstances and/or conditions occurring without human intervention and which no amount of foresight, precaution, or care reasonably exercised could have prevented.

provisions.name: 22. Other Documents; Audit
provisions.text:
## 22. OTHER DOCUMENTS; AUDIT

The terms, conditions and provisions of any invoice, billing statement, confirmation, receipt, bill of lading or other similar document relating to the Services rendered in connection with this Agreement shall be subject and subordinate to the terms, provisions and conditions of this Agreement and, in the event of a conflict between the terms, conditions and provisions of any such document and of this Agreement, the terms, conditions and provisions of this Agreement shall govern.

The rates, rules and regulations contained in this Agreement, and the Exhibits and Schedules thereto, will be the sole provisions governing the Services and will override any previous contract or tariff rates between the parties that may be on file. Any conflict between the provision set forth in this Agreement and the terms of any tariff it references shall be resolved in favor of the provisions set forth herein.

Customer and its duly authorized representatives shall have access to the accounting records and other documents maintained by Carrier which relate to the Services set forth in this Agreement, and shall have the right to review and copy such records at any reasonable time or times during the term of this Agreement and for a period of two years after such termination.

provisions.name: 23. Assignability of Contract
provisions.text:
## 23. ASSIGNABILITY OF CONTRACT

The provisions of this Agreement shall be binding upon the parties hereto and upon their successors and assigns for the full term of this Agreement. The parties agree that the terms and obligations herein contained shall not be affected, modified, altered, or changed in any respect by the transfer or assignment from Customer to their underlying Shipper.

provisions.name: 24. Entire Agreement
provisions.text:
## 24. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

This Agreement together with the attached Appendix, Exhibits and Schedules thereto and revisions and amendments thereof, contain the complete and exclusive agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter of this Agreement and supersedes all prior (whether oral or in writing) contracts, correspondence, negotiations or understandings. This Agreement supersedes and cancels all other previous agreements, rates and charges between the parties. If any provisions of the Exhibits and Schedules thereto are in conflict with the Agreement, the provisions of the Exhibits and Schedules shall control.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have set their hands and executed this agreement on the date first above written.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 100 – Appointment Notification
provisions.text:
### ITEM 100

#### APPOINTMENT NOTIFICATION

1. There shall be no charge assessed by Carrier for any costs or expenses involved in arranging or fulfilling an appointment with respect to pick up and delivery services to consignee or consignor.
2. Request for prearranged scheduling may be via phone or fax.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 120 – Detention With Power
provisions.text:
### ITEM 120

#### DETENTION WITH POWER

1. Rate $65.00 per hour or fraction thereof in excess of the two hours for situations when the Carrier offers a vehicle with a power unit for unloading at an agreed upon time and is unable to accomplish same within two hours. If a Carrier is early or late for an appointment to load or unload the vehicle, the difference between the appointment time and the arrival time shall not be included in the computation of time for the purposes of this item. Carrier shall indicate on freight bill whether detention occurred at origin or destination. The maximum charge is $390.

2. $/hour paid in 15 minute increments.
provisions.repairs: Removed a stray bullet line between items 1 and 2.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 130 – Storage – OTR Shipments
provisions.text:
### ITEM 130

#### STORAGE – OTR Shipments

1. Storage in-transit charge (OTR shipments) per day for situations where the Carrier is required by the Shipper to sign for and pick-up a trailer transferring dry freight from Shipper's facilities and hold for a period of time. After the expiration of two (2) business days free time (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, & Friday) charges may be assessed at $40.00 per day. No storage charge will be incurred for the first Saturday and Sunday while in carrier's possession.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 140 – Exclusive Use of Vehicle
provisions.text:
### ITEM 140

#### EXCLUSIVE USE OF VEHICLE

1. Each load tendered to Carrier is entitled to exclusive use of the trailer in which it is to be transported, except when a written request for non-exclusive use is provided to Carrier by Shipper.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 170 – Labor - Driver Loading or Unloading
provisions.text:
### ITEM 170

#### LABOR - DRIVER LOADING OR UNLOADING

1. Where consignee requires carrier personnel to sort and segregate freight for delivery, a driver unload charge may be assessed. $0.30 per hundred pounds; subject to a minimum charge of $50.00 per stop, and a maximum of $125 per shipment.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 180 – Layover
provisions.text:
### ITEM 180

#### LAYOVER

1. When, due to conditions beyond the carrier's control, the shipper or the consignee or the consignor cannot accept delivery or cannot complete loading or unloading, causing the carrier's truck and driver to be detained overnight, a layover charge will apply.
2. Rate per day for detention in excess of six hours.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 190 – Pick Up or Delivery
provisions.text:
### ITEM 190

#### PICK UP OR DELIVERY

1. Rates include one pick up and one delivery or one tender for delivery of a shipment, during business hours at one site, subject to the following provisions
- Placement of vehicle for loading: At the request of the Shipper, Carrier will furnish and place a vehicle at the loading site designated.
- Placement of vehicle for unloading: The delivery of a shipment will include the placing of vehicle at the site designated by the consignee.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 200 – Provisions Included in Base Rates
provisions.text:
### ITEM 200

#### PROVISIONS INCLUDED IN BASE RATES

1. Rates for the Services include one pick up and one delivery service for each shipment hereunder at all points within the commercial zone of the cities, towns, villages and other points from and to which the rates apply, except as otherwise specifically provided herein. The term "delivery" as used herein means the service performed by Carrier or its agent in transporting freight to consignee's receiving location from the Shipper's facilities.
2. Trailers tendered for shipping must be clean, free of odor, and free of insects. It will be the Shipper's sole judgement with the respect to cleanliness and sanitation if the unit is suitable for the transporting of said property.
3. By signing of this Agreement, Carrier certifies that no trailer is used for the transportation of Shipper's product, or for the transportation of items to Shipper, has ever been used for without sufficient cleaning and/or disinfecting or is being used for the hauling (or back hauling) of garbage, trash, hazardous waste, dried animal feed, toxic compound, broken glass, pesticides, fertilizers, petroleum products, solvents, strong aromatic compounds, or metal shavings/fragments, or other similar items.
4. Carrier agrees to take reasonable measures to maintain seal integrity and document and promptly notify Shipper of any seal removal prior to delivery.
5. Carrier shall only be allowed to stage a loaded trailer containing Shipper's products (if not at Shipper's facilities) only at a secure lot. Secure lot meaning: an area which is fenced with a locking gate or an area monitored /patrolled continuously by security.
6. Carrier shall notify shipper immediately of the discovery of any occurrence that results in spoiled, damaged, contaminated or lost freight, regardless of whether or not the product is known to be hazardous, and will await instructions or advice from Shipper before further loading, transporting or delivering any goods potentially affected.
7. Carrier shall provide Customer with shipment information by electronic means within a schedule agreed on by Customer and Carrier.
8. Upon request by Customer, Carrier shall provide written proof of delivery within one (1) working day of the request.
9. Carrier shall contact Customer by telephone or facsimile with notification of all delivery discrepancies (Overages, Shortages, Damages and Refusals) within 24 hours of delivery to receive instructions.
10. 2 hours free time for unloading with power.
11. Single shipment charge.
12. Inspection charge.
provisions.repairs: Joined the list across a page break, dropping the blank page filler.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 210 – Rate Base for Mileage Calculation Applications
provisions.text:
### ITEM 210

#### RATE BASE FOR MILEAGE CALCULATION APPLICATIONS

1. Mileage, if used for rating purposes, will be determined through use of PC Miler 2000, the version of which is in effect for Exel at time of tendering.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 220 – Re-consignments and/or Diversion
provisions.text:
### ITEM 220

#### RE-CONSIGNMENTS AND/OR DIVERSION

1. $150 plus applicable linehaul charge to point of reconsignment. Shipment shall be considered reconsigned if a new destination is identified prior to or after attempted delivery to the original destination on the bill of lading. Mileage to be calculated using PC Miler 2000, the version of which is in effect for Exel at time of tendering.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 230 – Return of Shipments
provisions.text:
### ITEM 230

#### RETURN OF SHIPMENTS

1. Shipments, which cannot be delivered for reasons beyond control of the carrier, will be returned to the shipper. The rate applicable for the return of such shipments will be as published in Schedule B herein, which is in effect on the date the shipment is returned.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 240 – Stops in Transit
provisions.text:
### ITEM 240

#### STOPS IN TRANSIT

1. When the carrier is requested to stop at any point(s) other than the initial shipment origin and the final shipment destination, the line haul price will be increased to account for all additional miles. $75.00 for the first additional stop, $125.00 for each stop thereafter with a maximum of 5 stops.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 250 – Expedited Team Service
provisions.text:
### ITEM 250

#### EXPEDITED TEAM SERVICE

1. $0.10 additional per mile surcharge to cover a second driver if expedited service is required to meet Shipper's delivery schedule.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 260 – Trailer Placement for Loading
provisions.text:
### ITEM 260

#### TRAILER PLACEMENT FOR LOADING

1. Carrier shall have the right to deliver or drop-at consignor's facilities, with consignor's consent, empty trailers to be loaded by consignor with one or more shipments for transportation by Carrier hereunder. Notwithstanding consignor's consent, each such delivery or drop-off shall be deemed to be for the sole convenience of Carrier and shall not be subject to the payment or collection of any charges for detention or demurrage therefore.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 270 – Truck Ordered Not Used
provisions.text:
### ITEM 270

#### TRUCK ORDERED NOT USED

1. Charge for situations when a driver with power unit is ordered into a facility to pick-up, but is not used. The fee shall not apply if order is cancelled eight or more hours prior to pick-up or if another load is provided. $250.00 minimum charge.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 280 – Out of Route Miles
provisions.text:
### ITEM 280

#### OUT OF ROUTE MILES

1. Charge per mile for any out-of-route miles for shipments. Out-of-route miles are defined as any additional miles driven beyond the standard route mileage as calculated using PC Miler 2000, V16 (Practical Miles).

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 290 – Lumper Charges
provisions.text:
### ITEM 290

#### LUMPER CHARGES

1. Whenever the carrier is required to hire a laborer ("lumper") to perform services on behalf of the shipper, consignor or consignee, the carrier will be entitled to reimbursement of actual lumper costs per event. Lumper charges will be passed through on a direct cost basis.
2. The price per shipment should default to the actual cost, and a copy of receipt should accompany carrier freight invoice. Lumper receipts are available upon request.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 300 – Redelivery
provisions.text:
### ITEM 300

#### REDELIVERY

1. If Carrier arrives late for an appointment, and is deemed as the cause for the consignee inability to unload, there will be no redelivery charges applicable.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 310 – Per Diem - Intermodal Only
provisions.text:
### ITEM 310

#### PER DIEM - INTERMODAL ONLY

1. Charge for equipment utilization beyond free time when equipment is out of possession of railroad will be $25 per day after the expiration of free time. Free time for Per Diem is fixed at both Origin and Destination.
2. At the Origin, free time is defined as the day the equipment is picked up from the rail plus two free days. The first weekend is free provided it falls within the free time. If the equipment is picked up on Thursday or Friday, the weekend is free. If it is picked up on Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday, the weekend is not free.

3. At the Destination, free time defined as the notify day plus two free days. The first weekend is free provided it falls within the free time. If the equipment notifies on Thursday or Friday, the weekend is free. If the equipment notifies on Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday, the weekend is not free.
provisions.repairs: Rejoined item 2, which was split across a page break.

provisions.name: Exhibit A, Item 320 – Intermodal Storage
provisions.text:
### ITEM 320

#### INTERMODAL STORAGE

1. Intermodal Storage - After the expiration of two (2) days free time, storage will be assessed at $100.00 per day. Free time will follow the same schedule as Per Diem - Intermodal (Item 310)

provisions.name: Preamble / Consideration
provisions.text: For valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, it is hereby agreed that:

provisions.name: 2. Warranty of sole interest

provisions.name: 3. Governing law; authority; counterparts
